title: ReleaseUpdateStep - Tooling API
description: Represents an individual release update step. Available in API version 49.0 and later.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The name of the release update step.

Number.description: The corresponding number for this release update step.

ReleaseUpdateId.description: The ID of the related release update. This field is a relationship field.

Status.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Status.description: The status of the release update step. Possible values are: Complete Incomplete New Started Viewed

special_access_rules: To enable or disable release updates, users must have the Manage Release Updates or Customize Application permission.
